title: RabbitSoftware.inc local app API v1
description: Between a user interface on this PC (the web page, the OS shell) and RabbitSoftware.inc (rabbitsoft/web.py), on http://127.0.0.1:8792. Every request needs the header X-Rabbit: 1 and a Host of 127.0.0.1 or localhost. Routes: POST /api/v1/message, POST /api/v1/poll, GET /api/v1/status, GET /api/v1/shell (see rabbitsoftware-shell-api-v1). The older /api/... routes are aliases.

messageRequest.description: POST /api/v1/message and /api/v1/poll. One session per browser tab; text is what the person typed (ignored by poll).

messageReply.description: What RabbitSoftware.inc says. choices are numbered options to show as buttons; confirm means the next answer should be yes or no.

pollReply.description: Background jobs that finished since the last reply; empty text means nothing new.

statusReply.description: GET /api/v1/status: one plain sentence each about the nodes and the chain.
